SYMPTOM: Maestro `assertVisible: "Whisnap"` passes immediately after 1 globe tap, but keyboard extension never actually launched. Test falsely succeeds.
CAUSE: iOS Safari shows a '◀ Whisnap' breadcrumb in the top-left corner (back-to-app button) after navigating from the Whisnap app. Maestro matches this text, not the keyboard toolbar.
FIX: Changed activate-keyboard.yaml to use `extendedWaitUntil: visible: "waveform"` — the mic button SF Symbol name, which only exists in the actual keyboard toolbar.
NOTE: Maestro CAN see accessibilityIdentifiers from the keyboard extension in some cases (keyboard.brandLabel, keyboard.micButton were visible once keyboard fully loaded), but 'waveform' text is more reliable.
